title: James Palmer Exclusive: What MUST the Broncos do to beat the Rams? | Orange & Blue Today
text: It’s a Wednesday edition of Orange & Blue Today, and Cecil Lammey is joined by NFL Insider James Palmer to preview Broncos vs Rams on Sunday Night Football — a matchup that will test Denver on both sides of the ball. The big storyline is the status of Puka Nacua. If he plays, the Rams passing game becomes even more dangerous. If he doesn’t, Matthew Stafford still has enough weapons and timing‑based concepts to stress Denver’s coverage rules. So what kind of problems does this Rams offense create, and can the Broncos generate enough pressure to rattle Stafford. On offense, Bo Nix faces a Rams secondary built from the former Chiefs defensive back room — a group that thrives on disguise, rotation, and forcing tight‑window throws. How does Nix handle that challenge, and what does Denver need to do schematically to keep him comfortable. And then there’s the backfield. Jonah Coleman stepped up in Week 2 while JK Dobbins dealt with a hamstring issue (later called cramps). Even if Dobbins suits up, are we about to see more Coleman as the Broncos search for stability and explosiveness in the run game. 🔥 In this episode: Whether Puka Nacua plays — and how it changes the matchup How Stafford challenges Denver’s defense How Bo Nix attacks the Rams secondary Why Jonah Coleman may keep expanding his role What the Broncos must fix before Sunday night Drop your thoughts in the comments — what’s the biggest key for Denver to beat the Rams on Sunday Night Football?

title: NFL Week 3 Preview: Will Giants replace Jaxson Dart in 2027 NFL Draft? Plus, new Power Rankings, Best Bets and Fantasy Sleepers
text: Manish Mehta and Eric Burgess delve into Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season. Before the guys discuss what lies ahead, they talk about the latest surrounding Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart’s season-ending knee injury suffered against the Los Angeles Rams. What will John Harbaugh & Co. do now? Will Jameis Winston be good enough to help the Giants make a playoff run? Burg and Manish explore quarterback options for the G-men like Jimmy Garoppolo, Joe Flacco, JJ McCarthy, Mitch Trubisky, Gardner Minshew and more. They also talk about the reckless speculation about Colin Kaepernick. Then, Manish explains why you shouldn’t rule out the possibility that John Harbaugh and the Giants will draft a quarterback like Texas QB Arch Manning in the 2027 NFL Draft. The guys discuss the Spygate-like allegations that Seattle Seahawks head coach Mike MacDonald accidentally revealed during a recent podcast. The Seahawks and Sean Payton’s Denver Broncos engaged in a “cold war” a couple years ago. The guys move on to their latest power rankings that include two newcomers. The weekly picks segments include their locks, underdog best bets and more. Finally, Manish reveals a few fantasy football sleeper starts of the week.

title: [FULL EPISODE] Is Case Keenum going to start against the Eagles?
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: The Bears' quarterback situation for Week 3 is suddenly murky. Backup quarterback Tyson Bagent is in concussion protocol, which means third-stringer Case Keenum could be the starter against the Eagles. Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote walk through everything they know. How much faith do the Bears have in Keenum if he has to start?
